role: rank which truncation point of the current SENSO parent to revisit

representation.feature_normalization_source: exact mean and scale arrays from the accepted V1 model export

architecture.output_during_ranking: same float32 score; higher is better

objective.major_change_from_v1: binary BCE to continuous completion-quality regression
objective.standardization: subtract float64 training-row mean and divide by float64 population standard deviation, then cast targets to float32; record both derived constants
objective.score_direction: larger predicted target ranks a lower final comparator count higher
objective.target_44_reference: forbidden; target uses only the observed integer final_count without thresholding or special weights

training.checkpoint_choice: highest calibration micro within-seed concordance, then lowest calibration MSE, then earliest epoch
training.concordance: pairs with unequal final_count within each seed; exact score ties contribute 0.5
training.duplicate_training_replay: same exported float arrays and SHA-256 required
training.hyperparameter_change_from_v1: none except loss and objective-dependent checkpoint metric

integration.duplicates: keep first occurrence only after clamping
